🚨🎙️| Raphinha: “Deco? When I arrived here, DECO was my agent. We had already been working together for seven years, and our friendship now goes back 10 years. Deco has been like a father to me and has done so much for me. He believed I could reach a club of this level long before I believed it myself. I don’t have an agent anymore; my wife and I manage my affairs. I have a fantastic relationship with Deco.” #fcblive
